scope.priorityInterpretation: Conditional upstream impact on key screens; not every API gap is a currently rendered defect. No all-flow gate.

findings.title: Wrong Chip selected palette and missing AI/size variants
findings.confidence: Source-proven mismatch against current variant fills; runtime effect unverified
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Upstream Chip should expose kind/size and use neutral selected default vs dark/inverse AI selected states; fix template selected/slot gate.

findings.title: Tabs drops composed variants and item affordances
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Provide fullWidth/extended and TabItem icon/badge support upstream; preserve selected/disabled in template.

findings.title: Generic docked/floating Panel and Rail have no runtime equivalent
findings.confidence: Missing family, not a Drawer mapping bug
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Keep Panel/Drawer distinct. Route Iris through existing PanelShell; request a genuine nonmodal Panel/Rail in shared source if key screens need it.

findings.title: Modal small remains 480px while live small specimen is 272px
findings.confidence: Source-proven geometry mismatch; runtime screenshot pending
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Correct small width and responsive min-width upstream; retain established modal composition.

findings.title: Callout side locations and imagePosition cannot render as specified
findings.confidence: Source-proven selector/unused prop findings; render result unverified
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Correct root location selectors and consume imagePosition upstream; preserve body/footer/image in template.

findings.title: FileUpload omits designed browse actions and template decouples helper limits from validation
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Add action/small/background coverage upstream; map numeric validation deliberately instead of presenting an unbound size helper.

findings.title: Templates read stale Boolean properties/slot types and lose designed content
findings.confidence: Current owner definitions vs source templates
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Refresh Breadcrumb, Chip, List and Table reads to current properties/slots, plus Modal title paths, Menu Item Text labels and Stepper Step Text labels. Replace Dropdown raw button example with design-system Button.

findings.title: Card image variants and start placement incomplete
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Add ratio/imageSpacing and correct start ordering upstream when image-heavy screens are in scope.

findings.title: Dismissible FilterTag drops trigger chevron
findings.confidence: Source branch omits showTrigger in split variant
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Honor showTrigger for split tag and add leading slot if required upstream.

findings.title: Table borders are mapped lossily and template reads removed selection prop
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Use existing DataTable for key list screens; preserve borderRule if generic Table fidelity is required upstream.

findings.title: Compact stepper and visited-but-incomplete state unsupported
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Add compact summary and independent completion state upstream only when a creation screen needs it.

findings.title: Non-Basic menu families largely implemented but mapping/docs understate coverage
findings.confidence: Positive coverage correction plus item-state gaps
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Document existing shortcut/icon/section/nested/selectable APIs; verify disabled nested items before relying on them.

findings.title: Supported Banner action variant and alignment differ
findings.confidence: Current Subtle specimen secondary action vs local tertiary; alignment prop absent
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Use Subtle for current designs; add alignment/borderRule support and correct action styling upstream if key screen requires it.

findings.title: Standalone Pagination lacks current info and size controls layout
findings.confidence: API gap; existing DataTable already covers key list use
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Prefer DataTable footer; avoid rebuilding pagination for list screens.

findings.title: TaskCard template drops visible header overflow action
findings.confidence: Template omission; runtime API already supports it
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Extract HasIcon? into showIcon and preserve custom footer subtype.

findings.title: Overlay is full-page shell, not Popover
findings.confidence: Structural non-equivalence verified by live screenshot
findings.proposedUpstreamWork: Preserve unresolved Popover mapping; use established DetailPageShell for record key screens.
